//: Copy to mobile-terminal-users.json to enable multi-tenancy. Each user has a shared token; devices log in with a username + that token. Tenancy is enforced only in-app under the one OS account -- it is an organizational boundary, not a security boundary (every tab is a real shell as this user). The 'owner' inherits the pre-existing tmux sessions and sees any session not claimed by another user. Point elsewhere with MOBILE_TERMINAL_USERS=/path/to/file.json. Delete the file to return to single-tenant mode.
